title: Allow unknown fields in inventory creation requests
plan: Remove strict unknown-field decoding from CreateInventory while preserving product_variant_id and status mapping.
Update the authenticated API regression test to prove a valid variant request succeeds when it includes the legacy product_price_id field.
Run focused Go tests, the broader backend test suite, and the shared documentation validation workflow.
contract: POST /api/inventories ignores unknown JSON fields; product_variant_id remains the creation identity and product_price_id is not used for creation.
